inlines.v: DISGORGE, verb transitive disgorj. 1. To eject or discharge from the stomach, throat or mouth; to vomit. 2. To throw out with violence; to discharge violently or in great quantities from a confined place. Thus, volcanoes are said to disgorge streams of burning lava, ashes and stones. Miltons infernal rivers disgorge their streams into a burning lake.
